target_customer: Platform and infrastructure engineers running Kubernetes clusters, clouds and sandboxes that need private connectivity, gateways and edge logic
problem: Connecting and securing workloads across clouds, clusters and platforms is complex and expensive, and running custom logic at the edge needs heavy infrastructure.
business_model: Usage and tiered SaaS (Free, Standard at $250 per month, Premium)

founders.name: Dmitry Ilyevsky
founders.background_notes: Per the YC page, 15 years on compute clusters and networking fabrics. Education not listed. A search summary names Matt Ward as a second founder but the YC page I opened lists only Ilyevsky, so he is not recorded.

competitors.name: Fastly Compute
competitors.what: WebAssembly based edge compute runtime (formerly Compute@Edge)

technical_complexity.rationale: Building a global relay network, encrypted tunnels and a high performance programmable runtime is systems-level work for a tiny team.

defensibility.rationale: Strong incumbents and open source alternatives exist; some lock-in from network configuration but copyable concepts.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action specific to Apoxy found; Cloudflare and Fastly already offered edge compute with WebAssembly support before 2023.

market_need_then: Multi-cloud and edge deployments were growing pain points, and WebAssembly at the edge was an established trend by 2021 per industry coverage. No company-specific demand evidence found.

identity.logo: Brand identity designed in 2023 just before the YC batch per a Dribbble case study
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and technical with short taglines

brand_strength.rationale: A designed identity exists but no press, community or memorable asset found; the name resembles epoxy and Apex-style names.

outcome_analysis: Apoxy is active as a very small team. Its product has moved from a multi-cloud and edge deployment pitch toward private networking for Kubernetes, clouds and agent sandboxes, with one named customer case study and an invite-only beta. No later funding, exit or shutdown was found, so the outcome is undetermined.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators (VCBacked, CB Insights, Extruct) report about $500K pre-seed or convertible note from Y Combinator and possibly Character Capital, dated 2023-09 or 2023-01. No primary announcement, so no round recorded. Product description moved over time (multi-cloud deployments, API proxy, networking mesh). Pivot date not established.
